facts.summary: An authorized PDS administrator can manage distributor or Fair Price Shop records through the applicable PDS administration system.
management_operations: Add a new distributor when permitted.
Manage distributor details associated with a Fair Price Shop.
Review distributor information required for PDS administration.
how_to_access: Log in using the authorized administrator account.
Enter or update the required information.
Save the changes through the authorized system workflow.
distributor_information: Operational information required by the applicable PDS system.
facts.add_distributor: If the system permits distributor creation, the administrator should enter the required information and complete any applicable verification or authorization process.
facts.update_distributor: Authorized administrators may update distributor information when permitted by the applicable system and administrative procedure.
facts.verification: Distributor information should be verified according to the applicable administrative procedure before creating or modifying a distributor record.
facts.access_control: Distributor information should only be accessed or modified by authorized administrative users.
facts.privacy: Distributor information should be handled only for legitimate PDS administration and according to applicable access-control requirements.
facts.state_specific: The available management operations, required fields, verification process and permissions can differ between States and Union Territories.
important_notes: Only authorized administrators should manage distributor records.
Do not modify distributor information without appropriate authorization.
Do not assume that every administrator has the same permissions.
The exact distributor-management workflow depends on the applicable PDS system.

faqs.question: Can an admin manage distributors?
faqs.answer: An authorized PDS administrator can manage distributor or Fair Price Shop records through the applicable administration system.

faqs.question: Can an admin add a distributor?
faqs.answer: If distributor creation is supported, an authorized administrator can add a distributor by entering the required information and completing the applicable verification or authorization process.

faqs.question: Can an admin update distributor details?
faqs.answer: An authorized administrator may update distributor information when the applicable system and administrative procedure permit it.

faqs.question: What distributor information can an admin manage?
faqs.answer: Depending on the system, this can include distributor identification, Fair Price Shop, contact and other operational information.

faqs.question: Who can modify distributor records?
faqs.answer: Distributor records should only be modified by users with the appropriate administrative authorization and system permissions.
